name: SUBI Concierge Agent
description: Agent for Space Universal Basic Income (SUBI): builds unsigned transactions for pledge deposits and UBI claims on Celo. Self-verified identity via passport NFC, perpetual Alaska POMV-style distribution, MiniPay integration. Track: Judges' Favorite | Telegram: @artugrande
capabilities: Build unsigned pledge transactions (treasury deposits with attribution)
Build unsigned claim transactions (UBI dividend withdrawal)
Build unsigned create pledge transactions (Space Dividend Pledge)
CIP-64 fee abstraction support (gas in stablecoins)
Multi-currency support (cUSD, USDC, wARS, Mento stables)
